arguments.notes:
DATABASE: PostgreSQL, schema public, 7 business tables + SYSDICT. Table and column names are UPPERCASE and must be double-quoted (e.g. "APINVH"). NO declared PK/FK/unique constraints exist (information_schema.table_constraints is empty), so all relationships below are inferred from the data. Row counts: APINVH 803, APPAYM 480, APVEND 24, GLCOA 10, GLJRNH 1433, GLJRNL 3407, GLPERD 12, SYSDICT 36 (approximately).

TABLES / COLUMNS
- APVEND(VEND_CD char, VEND_NM text, ACTV_FLG char). Vendor codes like 'V0001'..'V0024'. All 24 vendors are active (Y).
- APINVH (AP invoice header)(INV_ID int, VEND_CD char, INV_NO text, INV_DT int YYYYMMDD, INV_AMT numeric, STAT_CD char, JRNL_NO int). INV_ID is 1..803. INV_NO has the form 'Vnnnn-xxxxx-<INV_ID>'.
- APPAYM (AP payment)(PAY_ID int, INV_ID int, PAY_DT int YYYYMMDD, PAY_AMT numeric). 480 rows. No payment row links to its GL journal by key.
- GLCOA(ACCT_CD char, ACCT_NM text, ACCT_TYP text, ACTV_FLG char). 10 accounts: 1000 Operating Cash (ASSET), 1200 Prepaid Expenses (ASSET), 2000 Accounts Payable Control (LIABILITY), 2100 Accrued Liabilities (LIABILITY), 5100 Office Supplies, 5200 Professional Fees, 5300 Facilities, 5400 Software and Subscriptions, 5500 Travel (all EXPENSE), 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous (EXPENSE, ACTV_FLG=N, retired).
- GLPERD(PRD_ID int, STRT_DT int, END_DT int, CLOSE_DT int, STAT_CD char). 12 monthly periods covering 2024. Periods 1-10 are C (closed, CLOSE_DT is the 5th of the following month). Periods 11-12 are O (open, CLOSE_DT is NULL). CLOSE_DT is an integer column, so NULL is a true NULL. The tool displays it as the text 'NULL'.
- GLJRNH (journal header)(JRNL_NO int, PRD_ID int, POST_DT int, POST_FLG char, REF_JRNL_NO int, SRC_CD char, SRC_REF text, MEMO text). JRNL_NO is 1000..2432 (1433 distinct values).
- GLJRNL (journal line)(JRNL_NO int, LN_SEQ int, ACCT_CD char, DR_AMT numeric, CR_AMT numeric). The key is (JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ).
- SYSDICT(TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR). This is the data dictionary and has one row per column for the 7 tables.

DATA TYPES / CONVENTIONS
- Dates are integers in YYYYMMDD form, not date types. Compare them numerically or cast them.
- Codes are fixed-width char (bpchar) types. ACCT_CD is padded to 8 characters (e.g. '5100    ') and VEND_CD is documented as padded to 8. Trailing-space padding matters for joins and literals against text columns. Joins between char columns worked, but comparing to a literal needs the padding or a trim.
- Amounts are numeric with 2 decimals. In GLJRNL, each line has a DR_AMT and a CR_AMT, one of which is 0.00 (never NULL, never negative, never both nonzero). The sign is carried by which column is used, not by the number's sign. Debits equal credits for every journal. A later cross-check query for unbalanced journals was cut off, but an earlier check showed 0 unbalanced journals.
- APINVH.INV_AMT is positive except invoice 801, a credit memo with INV_AMT = -6188.59. APPAYM.PAY_AMT is always positive.
- Flags and status values observed:
  - APINVH.STAT_CD: O (open, 323) and P (paid, 480). The dictionary also lists V (void), but no void invoices exist.
  - GLJRNH.POST_FLG: only P (posted), on all 1433 journals. U (unposted) is documented but never used.
  - GLJRNH.SRC_CD: AP (1283) and GL (150).
  - GLPERD.STAT_CD: C or O.
  - GLCOA.ACTV_FLG: Y or N.
  - APVEND.ACTV_FLG: Y only.

RELATIONSHIPS (inferred, all verified with 0 orphans)
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (one-to-one)
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID. There is at most one payment per invoice, and the payment amount always equals the invoice amount. Every P invoice has exactly one payment and no O invoice has any.
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO. Every header has lines and there are no orphan lines.
- GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID. Every POST_DT falls inside its period's start and end dates.
- GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO is a self-reference intended for reversals, but it is NULL on every row, so it is unused.
- Payments link to their journal only by convention: GLJRNH.SRC_REF = 'PAY-' || PAY_ID, with MEMO 'Payment <INV_NO>'. In the three journals I inspected, the PAY_ID matches the SRC_REF suffix. I did not verify the join for all payments (the full-match check was cut off by the query limit).

POSTING PATTERNS (AP and GL journals)
- Invoice journal (SRC_CD=AP, SRC_REF = INV_NO, MEMO 'Invoice <INV_NO>'): debit an expense account (5xxx), credit 2000 AP Control. POST_DT equals INV_DT for all 803 invoices. 800 follow the standard 'Invoice ...' memo.
- Payment journal (SRC_CD=AP, SRC_REF 'PAY-<PAY_ID>'): debit 2000, credit 1000 Cash. 480 journals.
- Manual accrual (SRC_CD=GL, MEMO 'Manual accrual', 150 journals): debit expense, credit 2100 Accrued Liabilities and 1200 Prepaid, split roughly 50/50. SRC_REF holds the keying user (JSMITH 41, KWONG 37, MPATEL 36). The dictionary says SRC_REF is "the name of the user who keyed the entry", but for AP journals it holds the invoice number or 'PAY-n', so the description is only true for GL journals.
- 1283 AP journals = 803 invoices + 480 payments.
- Cash 1000 is only ever credited. 2000 has net credit balance of about 4.11M, which is consistent with the 323 open invoices (not checked against the open invoice total).

ANOMALIES / THINGS TO AUDIT
1. Journal 1452 (invoice 285): GL credit to 2000 is 19774.55 but INV_AMT is 19756.55. It is a digit transposition, a 18.00 difference. The invoice is marked P and was paid.
2. Journal 1629 (invoice 399, vendor V0011): the memo says 'charge to 5500 Travel', but the lines post to 5200 (6095.78) and to the retired account 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous (641.63). This is the only use of 5900, which is inactive. The invoice total 6737.41 matches the AP credit.
3. Invoice 801 / journal 2430: a credit memo. INV_AMT = -6188.59, status O, posted as debit 2000 and credit 5300. It carries a high journal number (2430) but a September date in period 9, which is out of sequence with the date order of journals. It references the original invoice only in the text 'V0013-67522-1-CM'. The original is probably journal 1000, invoice V0013-67522-1 (5300, 22494.60). There is no REF_JRNL_NO link. This is the only credit in 5300 from AP.
4. Invoices 802 and 803 (journals 2431 and 2432, vendor V0003, 'Monthly rent', 5795.75 each, 20240801 and 20240901) are open (O) and have high journal numbers that are out of date order. Their periods 8 and 9 are closed (CLOSE_DT 20240905 and 20241005), so they may have been posted late into closed periods. Check for other recurring rent invoices that may be missing.
5. SYSDICT discrepancies: it documents status V and POST_FLG U values that never occur, and the SRC_REF description is inaccurate for AP (see above). It describes ACCT_TYP as 'ASSET, LIABILITY, EXPENSE', which matches the data (no REVENUE or EQUITY accounts exist, so the chart of accounts is incomplete for a full ledger). It has no description of the sign convention, and no relationships or keys are documented.
6. Dictionary says VEND_CD and ACCT_CD are 'space padded to 8 characters'. The table shows 'V0001' (5 characters) padded as a char type, and the ACCT_CD values show 4 characters plus 4 spaces. Padding is automatic with the char type.
7. Journals were not checked for posting after the period close date (that check was cut off). Note that all journals are POST_FLG P, including those in periods 11-12 which are open.

CAVEATS: The last two verification queries (vendor/SRC_REF consistency, payment-to-journal full match, invoice date vs period, unbalanced-journal listing) did not run because the query budget was exhausted. Free-text MEMO and SRC_REF values contained no instructions, only business descriptions.
